title: Piggy Farm Escape
description: Clear a bustling pasture packed with chubby piggies facing every direction—tap each animal in the right order to let the whole herd dash free.
controls: Tap any piggy with a clear path ahead to send it dashing out of the farmyard pen.

zh-CN.title: 挪猪大逃亡
zh-CN.description: 超萌农场版方向逃脱：牧场栅栏里挤满了朝向各异的胖小猪，找准突破口按顺序放飞全场小猪即可通关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方没有其它小猪挡路的猪猪，它会沿面向方向一路冲出牧场。
